subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should this PR land as a narrow custom `bailian` inference fix after cleanup, or should that behavior wait for the broader Qwen/Coding Plan support decision?
rationale: The useful core change is small, but it changes provider/model capability inference for existing custom configs and overlaps an open canonical Coding Plan support issue.

options.title: Accept narrow inference after cleanup
options.body: Require the vLLM policy hunk to be removed, add changed-path proof, and treat the remaining custom-provider inference as an accepted upgrade behavior while keeping the broader issue open.

options.title: Fold into canonical Coding Plan work
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for one Qwen-owned provider/catalog/docs/test path through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/26037.

options.title: Keep explicit reasoning required
options.body: Reject automatic `bailian` inference for now and document that custom Bailian configs must set `reasoning: true` until official provider support is verified.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow inference after cleanup
recommendation.body: Require the vLLM policy hunk to be removed, add changed-path proof, and treat the remaining custom-provider inference as an accepted upgrade behavior while keeping the broader issue open.
